article.title: What do you do when you can’t hear the bombs? Being deaf during the Gaza genocide.
article.author: Jumana Mughari
article.content: Amid Israel’s genocide in Gaza, Palestinians with hearing impairments have been left particularly vulnerable, unable to hear incoming missiles or evacuation orders. Fadl Kuraz is one of the few who have devoted their lives to helping them survive.
